comments.text: The vote is specifically for Rengeteki. The honor of being the only character to appear in more than 1 PC98 game (besides the playable ones) was given to the nameless midboss :P. Jokes aside, I think Rengeteki is very interesting. We first see her in LSS in Mugenkan serving Yuuka and fighting for her, but in MS she switches sides and instead works(?) for Alice. You come up with your own explanation for these events, from Rengeteki betraying Yuuka to Alice stealing Rengeteki from Yuuka.
